Title: Maintenance Proposals Current State
Content: The /proposals workbench is the authenticated approval surface for maintenance-agent and chat-agent write proposals. MaintenanceProposalWorkflow persists proposal JSON through FileMaintenanceProposalStore, records open/respond/approve/reject/revision history, applies approved file changes only after current file content still matches the proposal before-text, and blocks closed proposal changes. The Proposals UI lists proposals, shows a human quick summary before metadata, renders diff/evidence/comments/topic-map tabs, can run maintenance tasks, and shows recent maintenance task activity from MaintenanceAgentService.ListRecentActivityAsync. The proposal action area uses a full-width comment row above a second row containing Request Agent Review, Approve, Respond, and Reject buttons. Maintenance runs publish current process-local active task state through MaintenanceActiveRunStore while RunAsync is executing, so /proposals and /maintenance refreshes can show trigger/task/start time even when a different scoped page instance observes the run. Maintenance runs also write latest-run state to LastRunPath and append compact JSONL activity summaries with task names, finding/proposal counts, proposal ids, warnings, and skipped status to ActivityLogPath. The /maintenance page is the Admin-only task/history workbench: it exposes run controls, active-run state, task trace history, proposal action history from proposal records, non-mutating maintenance-agent chat, transcript search, and links back to proposal review. Chat Agent memory/page write approval now submits a MaintenanceWriteProposal through MemoryChatAgent.ApplyAgentWritesAsync when MaintenanceProposalWorkflow is registered; submitted proposal ids are stored on the chat turn and no memory/page file is changed until /proposals approval applies the diff. MaintenanceAgentConfigService resolves optional Admin Models assignments for maintenance runs, proposal reviews, and Admin Maintenance chat before falling back to the legacy maintenance provider/model fields. Admin Maintenance chat uses MaintenanceAgentService.SendAdminMessageAsync and transcript entries from TranscriptLogPath; in production DI, SendAdminMessageAsync delegates to MemoryChatAgent in Chat mode with the maintenance-agent system instruction so the conversation can use the same read-only wiki tool pipeline as Chat while still refusing memory/page writes, proposal approval, or file changes. Transcript writes retain up to TranscriptRetentionEntries JSONL entries and redact common token/API key/secret/password/authorization patterns when TranscriptRedactionEnabled is true. The Request Agent Review button calls MaintenanceAgentService.ReviewProposalAsync. Review execution records agent_review_requested and agent_review_completed history/comments without changing the original proposal status; when the provider returns a valid revised proposal, SubmitAgentRevisionAsync saves the revision with metadata.supersedes and records agent_revision_proposed on the original while keeping both proposals reviewable. Maintenance LLM task output and proposal review parsing strip fenced code blocks and surrounding text before JSON deserialization, so providers that wrap JSON in fenced json responses no longer skip review solely because the first byte is a backtick.
